title: Weekend work with Harry James
summary: Bellson briefly describes James, a former circus drummer, with the band working weekends in semi-retirement.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Then after the sextet you played with Harry James. Is that correct?
How long were you with Harry?

He played drums for the circus. He’d come from a circus band, and he could play the drums. He could play all the gallops. He could play. Great trumpet player too. We were working just weekends with Harry. He was semi-retired. Great player. I had a great time with Harry.
